title: feat(spec)!: ListView.userActions.editInline defaults to true on the v18 line; editInline: false is the opt-out (#22605, spec half)
body:
Part of #22605
Clause-②: no

The spec half of #22605: `ListView.userActions.editInline` defaults to `true` on the v18 line, and `userActions: { editInline: false }` is the opt-out. The `skills/**` paragraph the card also asks for is a separate pull request (Tier H), so this one is `Part of`, not `Fixes`.

## The ruling

Maintainer, 2026-10-10, verbatim (filed by the director seat on the card): 「乙 v18 把 spec 默认翻成 true,editInline: false 变成关法。」 A list view is editable in place by default, under the permission gate that already exists. The rule of objectui#5144 stands (one vocabulary, the `inlineEdit` fold, declared = enforced); only the default's value changes. Not taken: declaring `editInline: true` on every existing view (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2048 and #22604 are superseded by the ruling, and stay open here — this PR does not act on either), and an app-level default. The permission gate is untouched. The consumer half is objectui's, objectstack-ai/objectui#12086; in the window the console at the pinned objectui still reads an absent key as off, so nothing regresses against today.

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` — `UserActionsConfigSchema.editInline` is `z.boolean().default(true)`, `describe` rewritten (on by default; a user who may update the object edits a cell in place with the field's type-aware widget, under the permission gate; declare `editInline: false` to make the list read-only in place). The schema docblock records the ruling beside the group/hideFields/rowColor asymmetry it already explains.
- `packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts` — `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR[17]` gains `ui/UserActionsConfig:editInline` `false` → `true` with its reason. This is what lets `check:authorable-surface` accept the moved fingerprint; `CURRENT_MAJOR` is the package major (17) until the version pass takes the group to 18. The build printed `📌 1 declared default change(s) accepted (#4666): ui/UserActionsConfig:editInline: false → true`.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.list-view-edit-inline-default-on.ts` — the D3 semantic entry (protocol 18), concatenated into `registry.ts` by `gen:migration-registry`.
- `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/ui.json` — regenerated by the build: `ui/UserActionsConfig:editInline = true`.
- `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` (3 rows), `content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx` (1 row) — regenerated by `gen:docs`: `optional (default: true)` with the new describe.
- `.changeset/22605-spec-list-view-edit-inline-default-on.md` — `@objectstack/spec: minor`, `Clause-②: no` (a moved default changes no accept set; the breaking signal is the banner and the ADR-0087 marker), the launch-window BREAKING banner naming the author who relied on the documented default for a read-only list and the remedy `editInline: false`, the FROM → TO table, the measured reach, and the ADR-0087 marker `registered list-view-edit-inline-default-on`. `minor` because the launch-window convention ships a breaking change as `minor` (`check-changeset-no-major`), and the fixed group already carries the pending `major` that opens the v18 line, so the level moves no version on its own.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.test.ts` — the defaults pin flips to `true`, plus four pins: an absent key parses to `true` (on `UserActionsConfigSchema` and through `ListViewSchema`), an explicit `false` stays `false`, an explicit `true` stays `true`, and the view-level `inlineEdit: true` still parses as before with no `userActions` block materialised (the fold is the renderer's; the spec keeps both spellings as declared).

## Measured first (the PM's mechanism assumptions)

1. **Other sites stating the old default.** `view.zod.ts:1535` read `.default(false)` with the "Off by default" describe — corrected. The four reference rows regenerate. Nothing else in the tree states the old default: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` lists the view-level `inlineEdit` with no default; `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx:667` is about `record:details`' own `inlineEdit` (a different key, renderer default on); `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` retired-key guidance says only that `editInline` is a view key; `object-strictness-batch20.test.ts` lists key names. Left as they are, with reasons: `.changeset/console-20c6d351ad74.md` describes the console at pin `20c6d351ad74`, which still reads an absent key as off until objectui#12086 lands and the pin moves (true of that build); `CHANGELOG.md:1677` and `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` are release-owned history.
2. **ADR-0087 disposition.** `check:adr-0087-registration` demands a marker on a declared-breaking changeset; `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` is refused when the body carries a prescription, and this one prescribes `editInline: false`. The honest disposition is `registered`: a D3 semantic entry at step 18, the same class as `view-pagination-page-size-default-50` and protocol 12's `rest-requireauth-default-flip`. No key is removed (no tombstone, no `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` row) and no D2 conversion exists — a mechanical pass writing `editInline: false` into every silent view would preserve the old posture and defeat the ruling. The registry regenerated byte-exact after merging `origin/main` (which brought the sibling entry `page-slots-details-beside-tabs-refused`, not adjacent in id order; `check:migration-registry` green). A second ledger also applies: the authorable-defaults ratchet refuses an undeclared default move, so `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR` carries the hop.
3. **Reach of the remedy**, at `e11ef3a7bd` (`git grep`, tests and changelogs excluded): 0 `editInline: false` and 0 `editInline: true` across `examples/**` and `packages/**` metadata. Views that declare nothing and now gain the toggle: 38 list-kind views with an explicit `type` across 10 example `*.view.ts` files (entries with no `type` are grid by default and count the same way), 12 `interfaceConfig` page lists across 5 showcase page files (11 declare a `userActions` block, none naming `editInline`), 105 list-kind views across 40 platform `*.object.ts` files in `packages/**`. One view declares the view-level `inlineEdit: true` (the showcase `task` grid saved view) and keeps opening in edit mode. The only test that asserted the old default is `view.test.ts` (`expect(config.editInline).toBe(false)`), flipped here; no other package's tests read the view-level `userActions` default (consumer tests on `userActions` are the object-level CRUD block). The card's readings outside this repository (cloud `sys-package.page.ts:105` declares `editInline: false`; HotCRM's 41 undeclared views) were not re-measured here.
4. **The skill file** `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` is hand-written: the only generated lifts inside `skills/**` are `references/_index.md` and `references/react-blocks.md` (`GENERATED_SURFACE_EXCEPTIONS`). Its paragraph is PR 2.

## Ablation (reverse verification)

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts --anchor 'editInline: z.boolean().default(true)' --replacement 'editInline: z.boolean().default(false)' -- pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/ui/view.test.ts`, at head `24d9bdcbf0`, after the fix was committed. Mutation proved on disk: anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `6979ade6158a` → `e0e02cd7f858`. Direction observed: red, exactly the two default pins — `should apply default values` and `an absent key parses to true` (`expected false to be true`), `2 failed | 462 passed (464)`. Restore proved: blob after restore `6979ade6158a` == blob at HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, tree clean. Resolution path: the pin imports the schema from the package's own `src` (no `dist` in the path), so no rebuild sits between the mutation and the reading.

## Gates (local, at `24d9bdcbf0`)

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; the tool reads the change set off the merge base): 115 families. Reconciled with `--ran`: 115 derived, 114 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 1 UNRUN — the UNRUN is `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, declared NOT MEASURED by the dispatch (it needs a whole-workspace build). Every other derived family exited 0, after building the prerequisites some of them load (`@objectstack/formula`, `lint`, `client`, `client-react`, `objectql`), except `pnpm check:dts-closure`, which exited 1 for a missing `dist/` under `plugin-approvals` and `plugin-dev`: it reads every package's built declarations, so without the whole-workspace build it is NOT MEASURED, not red (CI's Build Core covers it). The artifact-roster block (49 families): 46 run, every one exit 0 except `pnpm check:published-readme-exports`, exit 3 (44 unbuilt packages, NOT MEASURED for the same reason); the three PR-context guards (`check-closing-target-claim`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`, `check-single-claim-paths`) run once this PR has a number, and their readings go in the report comment on the card. Staleness note the tool prints: the derivation tree is two commits behind `origin/main` `83b8b80728`, and the one derivation input that moved is `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json` (the tenancy-census roster); that family ran green on the older copy, and no path of this diff overlaps those two commits.

Lint, as a proven narrowing rather than the CI-owned `pnpm lint`: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the `.ts`/`.mjs` files in the two-point diff — 24 files linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings (the count is from the JSON output; the set is wider than this PR's own 9 files (233 insertions, 7 deletions off the merge base `e22315238f`) because the two-point diff includes the merged sibling commits). Population, read from `eslint.config.mjs`: `**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}` minus its `ignores`, so the `.md`, `.mdx` and `.json` files of this diff are outside it (eslint reports them "ignored because no matching configuration"). Invariance: the config declares no `parserOptions.project` and no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules, so this diff cannot move the verdict of any file it does not touch.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/spec-changes.json` and `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` are not regenerated here. Since #22449 B′ the PR-stage `check:spec-changes` and `check:upgrade-guide` project the registry in memory and compare no committed copy (the publish lane generates the shipped one), and `origin/main` turned the upgrade guide into a pointer stub while this branch was open; a regeneration on the pre-merge tree carried 30-odd lines of sibling drift this diff does not own, so it was reverted. The entries README still says to regenerate both; the generator header is the newer authority. Noted, not filed.
- The objectui consumer half (`editInline !== false` in `ListView.tsx` and `InterfaceListPage.tsx`, the `plugin-view.mdx` row, the flipped pins) is objectstack-ai/objectui#12086, filed by the claiming seat; nothing in objectui moves here.
